title: 第19章 雷电淬体第20章 赛制
slug: 满级雷灵根卷哭修仙界
lines: 休息片刻后，第一场加赛开始。
林枝意对阵云逸，这是雷灵根与冰灵根、天生剑体之间的对决。
上台前，林枝意看着眼睛还红红的云逸，小大人似的拍拍他的肩
“云逸，男孩子不能老哭鼻子的，你还要不要当最厉害的剑修了？”
云逸用力抹了把脸，小脸上浮现出罕见的坚毅“要……”
“那开始吧！”林枝意摆开架势，周身已有紫色电光流转。
裁判长老一声令下，比试开始。
云逸率先出手，玄冰剑指直取林枝意面门。
冰凌带着刺骨的寒气呼啸而至，轨迹刁钻，尽显天生剑体的精妙掌控。
林枝意不慌不忙，雷盾术瞬间成型，精准地挡下所有冰凌。
同时反手一记雷击术，紫色电光直扑云逸。
云逸急忙凝水成冰，在身前竖起一道冰墙。雷光击中冰墙，发出刺耳的滋滋声。
就在这时，意外发生了——
冰墙在雷电的高温下迅速融化，而融化的水竟然导电！
电流顺着水流蔓延，不仅击中了云逸，也反弹回了林枝意自己身上。
“哎呀！”
“呜哇！”
两个小团子同时被电得跳起来，头发根根竖起，小脸乌黑。
台下一片哗然。
“冰会融化，水能导电这”
“伤敌一千自损八百啊！”
“这两个小家伙也太乱来了！”
林枝意甩了甩发麻的小手，大眼睛却亮了起来。
她发现被反弹回来的雷电虽然让她发麻，但其中一部分竟然被她的身体吸收了，转化为精纯的灵力！
【这是雷电淬体？】系统震惊地检测着宿主体内的变化，【雷灵根竟然还能这样修炼？】
“云逸，再来！”
林枝意兴奋地喊道，主动撤去雷盾，任由云逸的冰系法术攻击自己。
云逸虽然不解，但还是依言施展冰刺诀。
地面冒出数道冰刺，林枝意不闪不避，反而主动迎上去，在冰刺即将命中时释放雷击术。
冰与雷再次碰撞，融化的冰水导电，强烈的电流瞬间席卷整个比武台。
两个小团子再次被电得浑身发抖，但这次林枝意早有准备，她运转《九霄御雷真诀》，疯狂吸收着反弹回来的雷电之力。
“好、好麻”云逸第一次经历这种全方位的电击，小脸皱成了一团，眼看金豆子又要往下掉。
content_en:
After a short break, the first extra game begins.
Lin Zhiyi versus Yun Yi, this is a duel between thunder spirit roots, ice spirit roots, and natural sword bodies.
Before going on stage, Lin Zhiyi looked at Yun Yi, whose eyes were still red, and patted him on the shoulder like a little adult.
"Yun Yi, boys can't cry all the time. Do you still want to be the most powerful swordsman?"
Yun Yi wiped his face vigorously, and a rare determination appeared on his face: "I want..."
"Then let's begin!" Lin Zhiyi opened his posture, and purple electric light was flowing around him.
The elder referee gave the order and the competition began.
Yun Yi was the first to take action, pointing the Xuan Bing sword directly at Lin Zhi's face.
The ice roared with biting cold air, and its trajectory was tricky, showing the exquisite control of the natural sword body.
Lin Zhiyi was unhurried, and the thunder shield technique formed instantly, accurately blocking all the ice.
At the same time, he made a lightning strike with his backhand, and the purple lightning shot straight at Yun Yi.
Yun Yi hurriedly condensed the water into ice and erected an ice wall in front of him. The lightning struck the ice wall, making a harsh sizzling sound.
Just then, an accident happened——
The ice wall melted rapidly under the high temperature of lightning, and the melted water actually conducted electricity!
The electric current spread along the water flow, not only hitting Yun Yi, but also bounced back to Lin Zhiyi himself.
"Ouch!"
"Whoa!"
The two little dumplings were electrocuted at the same time so much that they jumped up, their hair stood on end, and their little faces were dark.
The audience was in an uproar.
"Ice melts and water conducts electricity."
"Injure the enemy by one thousand, and injure yourself by eight hundred!"
"These two little guys are too messy!"
Lin Zhiyi shook his numb little hands, but his big eyes lit up.
She found that although the rebounded lightning made her numb, part of it was absorbed by her body and transformed into pure spiritual power!
[Is this lightning tempered body? ] The system was shocked to detect the changes in the host's body, [Can Lei Linggen still be practiced like this? 】
"Yun Yi, come again!"
Lin Zhiyi shouted excitedly, taking the initiative to remove the thunder shield and letting Yun Yi's ice spells attack him.
Although Yun Yi was puzzled, he still followed the instructions and used the Ice Thorn Technique.
Several ice spikes appeared on the ground. Lin Zhiyi did not dodge them. Instead, he took the initiative to meet them and released his lightning strike when the ice spikes were about to hit.
"Boom——!"
Ice and thunder collided again, the melted ice water conducted electricity, and a strong current swept through the entire competition arena instantly.
The two little dumplings were trembling with electricity again, but this time Lin Zhiyi was well prepared. She ran the "Nine Heavens Lightning Control Technique" and frantically absorbed the rebounding power of thunder and lightning.
"Good, so numb." Yun Yi experienced this kind of all-round electric shock for the first time. His little face wrinkled up, and he saw that the golden beans were about to fall down again.
